sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 3x to 6x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 80. Applies Beguilement for 30 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 50 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% elevation for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Applies Star Unison Lock to the enemy Field for 120 seconds.
Only [War God] Sutekh can be used as Unlocking Potential material
